---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

Write all project documentation in English.

Keep links relative when they point to repository files. Preserve ADR history:
change an Accepted decision through a new superseding ADR rather than silently
rewriting the original decision.

Do not claim that implementation, tests, or commands exist unless they are
present in the repository. Keep architecture, roadmap, and acceptance criteria
consistent with the development DAG.
